notes: RunsOn Flex predefined runner "1cpu-linux-arm64" (EC2 families m8g, m9g, t4g; memory 2 to 8 GiB; Spot by default, spot=false for on-demand). vCPU is "1 or 2" depending on the instance picked, so vcpu is null. $0 is RunsOn's per-minute charge only: the EC2 instance, EBS and traffic are billed by AWS to your account at AWS prices (to the second); RunsOn adds a flat annual license. See the provider notes.
